```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionAnalysis)
library(MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

repo_local_dir = file.path(here(), 
                           "figures",
                           "adipose")
files_dir = file.path(repo_local_dir, "Files")
cmeans_dir = file.path(repo_local_dir, "cmeans")

source(file.path(cmeans_dir, "cmeans_helpers.R"))
```

The cell type markers ship as a list, but `path_to_gmt` reads GMT, so convert
once here. Despite the extension, `ba_svf_markers_v2.rds` is a `save()` archive
holding `ba_svf_list`, so it is read with `load()`.
```{r celltype_gmt}
load(file.path(files_dir, "ba_svf_markers_v2.rds"))
#loads ba_svf_list into the environment

celltype_gmt = file.path(files_dir, "ba_svf_markers_v2.gmt")

# GMT rows are ragged (set, description, members...), which write.table
# cannot emit.
writeLines(
  vapply(names(ba_svf_list),
         function(set) {
           paste(c(set, "ba_svf_markers_v2.rds", ba_svf_list[[set]]),
                 collapse = "\t")
         },
         character(1)),
  con = celltype_gmt
)
```

So here want to do c-means results by modality, plot them, and do enrichment on all
```{r}
for(modality in c("Resist", "Endur")){
  outdir = file.path(files_dir, "c_means_adipose", modality)
  dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  modality_clusters = run_cmeans(selected_tissues = "adipose",
                                 selected_omes = c("transcript-rna-seq", "metab"),
                                 modality = modality)
  
  write.csv(modality_clusters[["adipose"]]$membership,
            file = paste0(outdir, "/", modality, "_specific_clusts.csv"),
            row.names = TRUE)
  
  plot_cmeans(modality_clusters[["adipose"]],
              modality = modality,
              min_membership = 0.3,
              filename = paste0(outdir, "/", modality, "_specific_clusts.pdf"))
  
  ORA = run_cluster_ORA(modality_clusters,
                        selected_omes = c("transcript-rna-seq", "metab"),
                        selected_tissues = "adipose") %>%
    arrange(adj_p_value)
  write.csv(ORA,
            file = paste0(outdir, "/", modality, "_specific_enrichments.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Markers are gene symbols, so transcripts only. overlap_cutoff = 0 because
  # most of a marker set falls outside the clustered background.
  celltype_ORA = run_cluster_ORA(modality_clusters,
                                 selected_omes = "transcript-rna-seq",
                                 selected_tissues = "adipose",
                                 path_to_gmt = celltype_gmt,
                                 overlap_cutoff = 0) %>%
    arrange(adj_p_value)
  write.csv(celltype_ORA,
            file = paste0(outdir, "/", modality, "_specific_celltype_enrichments.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  celltype_block = celltype_ORA %>%
    transmute(block = "Cell type",
              set_label = unname(CELLTYPE_LABELS[as.character(set)]),
              cluster, p_value, adj_p_value)
  if (anyNA(celltype_block$set_label))
    stop("CELLTYPE_LABELS is missing an entry for one of the marker sets.")
  
  refmet_block = ORA %>%
    filter(collection == "REFMET") %>%
    transmute(block = "Metabolite class",
              set_label = as.character(set_short),
              cluster, p_value, adj_p_value)
  
  heatmap_parts = build_cluster_bubble_heatmap(bind_rows(celltype_block,
                                                         refmet_block))
  
  panel_title = paste0(MODALITY_LABELS[modality],
                       " (Transcriptomics + Metabolomics)")
  
  save_combined_panel(
    traj_plot = plot_cmeans_facets(modality_clusters[["adipose"]],
                                   modality = modality,
                                   min_membership = 0.3),
    heatmap_parts = heatmap_parts,
    filename = paste0(outdir, "/", modality, "_specific_cmeans_enrichment_panel.pdf"),
    title = panel_title)
  
}
```
